name: text-loop
title: Text Loop
description: A seamless text marquee that flows along curved SVG paths.

files.content:
<script module lang="ts">
	type CSSProperties = Record<string, string | number | undefined | null>;

	export type TextLoopShape = 'wave' | 'circle' | 'infinity' | 'arch' | 'line';
	export type TextLoopDirection = 'forward' | 'reverse';

	export interface TextLoopProps {
		text?: string;
		shape?: TextLoopShape;
		path?: string;
		speed?: number;
		direction?: TextLoopDirection;
		separator?: string;
		curviness?: number;
		tilt?: number;
		fontSize?: number;
		fontWeight?: number | string;
		letterSpacing?: number;
		uppercase?: boolean;
		color?: string;
		ribbon?: boolean;
		ribbonColor?: string;
		ribbonWidth?: number;
		edgeFade?: number;
		pauseOnHover?: boolean;
		cross?: boolean;
		crossColor?: string;
		crossAngle?: number;
		draggable?: boolean;
		scrollBoost?: number;
		outline?: boolean;
		outlineWidth?: number;
		className?: string;
		style?: CSSProperties;
	}

	interface Metrics {
		length: number;
		reps: number;
		crossLength: number;
		crossReps: number;
	}

	interface FadeStop {
		offset: number;
		opacity: number;
	}

	const VIEW_W = 1200;
	const VIEW_H = 520;
	const CX = VIEW_W / 2;
	const CY = VIEW_H / 2;
	const EDGE_PAD = 6;
	const FADE_STEPS = 8;
	const MAX_FLING = 2600;
	const MAX_BOOST = 1600;

	const smootherstep = (t: number) => t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10);
	const clamp = (v: number, min: number, max: number) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, v));
	const wrap = (v: number, length: number) => ((v % length) + length) % length;

	const circleRadius = (curviness: number, ribbonWidth: number) =>
		Math.min(90 + Math.max(0, curviness) * 0.95, Math.max(20, CY - Math.max(0, ribbonWidth) / 2 - EDGE_PAD));

	const buildPath = (shape: TextLoopShape, curviness: number, ribbonWidth: number, mirrored = false): string => {
		const c = Math.max(0, curviness);
		const room = Math.max(20, CY - Math.max(0, ribbonWidth) / 2 - EDGE_PAD);
		const flip = mirrored ? -1 : 1;

		switch (shape) {
			case 'circle': {
				const r = circleRadius(curviness, ribbonWidth);
				if (mirrored) {
					const rx = r * 1.22;
					const ry = r * 0.42;
					return `M ${CX - rx} ${CY} A ${rx} ${ry} 0 1 1 ${CX + rx} ${CY} A ${rx} ${ry} 0 1 1 ${CX - rx} ${CY} Z`;
				}
				return `M ${CX - r} ${CY} A ${r} ${r} 0 1 1 ${CX + r} ${CY} A ${r} ${r} 0 1 1 ${CX - r} ${CY} Z`;
			}
			case 'infinity': {
				const r = 150 + c * 1.4;
				const h = Math.min(60 + c * 0.95, room);
				return [
					`M ${CX} ${CY}`,
					`C ${CX + r * 0.55} ${CY - h} ${CX + r} ${CY - h} ${CX + r} ${CY}`,
					`C ${CX + r} ${CY + h} ${CX + r * 0.55} ${CY + h} ${CX} ${CY}`,
					`C ${CX - r * 0.55} ${CY - h} ${CX - r} ${CY - h} ${CX - r} ${CY}`,
					`C ${CX - r} ${CY + h} ${CX - r * 0.55} ${CY + h} ${CX} ${CY}`,
					'Z'
				].join(' ');
			}
			case 'arch': {
				const rise = Math.min(120 + c * 1.1, room * 2) * flip;
				return `M 120 ${CY + rise / 2} Q ${CX} ${CY - rise * 1.5} ${VIEW_W - 120} ${CY + rise / 2}`;
			}
			case 'line':
				return `M -320 ${CY} L ${VIEW_W + 320} ${CY}`;
			case 'wave':
			default: {
				const a = Math.min(c * 2.2, room * 2) * flip;
				return `M -320 ${CY} Q -160 ${CY - a} 0 ${CY} T 320 ${CY} T 640 ${CY} T 960 ${CY} T 1280 ${CY} T ${VIEW_W + 320} ${CY}`;
			}
		}
	};

	const buildFade = (edgeFade: number): FadeStop[] => {
		const width = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, edgeFade)) * 0.3;
		if (width <= 0) return [];
		const stops: FadeStop[] = [];
		for (let i = 0; i <= FADE_STEPS; i++) {
			const t = i / FADE_STEPS;
			stops.push({ offset: t * width, opacity: smootherstep(t) });
		}
		for (let i = FADE_STEPS; i >= 0; i--) {
			const t = i / FADE_STEPS;
			stops.push({ offset: 1 - t * width, opacity: smootherstep(t) });
		}
		return stops;
	};

	const parseHex = (value?: string): number[] | null => {
		const match = /^#?([\da-f]{3}|[\da-f]{6})$/i.exec(String(value || '').trim());
		if (!match) return null;
		const hex = match[1].length === 3 ? match[1].replace(/./g, (ch) => ch + ch) : match[1];
		return [0, 2, 4].map((i) => parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
	};

	const tint = (color: string, amount: number): string => {
		const rgb = parseHex(color);
		if (!rgb) return color;
		return `#${rgb
			.map((v) =>
				Math.round(v + (255 - v) * amount)
					.toString(16)
					.padStart(2, '0')
			)
			.join('')}`;
	};

	const inkOn = (color: string): string => {
		const rgb = parseHex(color);
		if (!rgb) return '#ffffff';
		const [r, g, b] = rgb.map((v) => {
			const c = v / 255;
			return c <= 0.04045 ? c / 12.92 : ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
		});
		return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b > 0.2 ? '#14110E' : '#ffffff';
	};

	const UNITLESS = /^(opacity|zIndex|fontWeight|lineHeight|flex|flexGrow|flexShrink|order|scale|aspectRatio)$/;

	const css = (value: CSSProperties | undefined) =>
		Object.entries(value ?? {})
			.filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '')
			.map(([key, v]) => {
				const name = key.startsWith('--') ? key : key.replace(/[A-Z]/g, (letter) => '-' + letter.toLowerCase());
				return `${name}:${typeof v === 'number' && !UNITLESS.test(key) ? `${v}px` : v}`;
			})
			.join(';');
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import { untrack } from 'svelte';
	import { gsap } from 'gsap';

	let {
		text = 'Svelte ✦ Bits',
		shape = 'wave',
		path,
		speed = 90,
		direction = 'forward',
		separator = '✦',
		curviness = 90,
		tilt = 0,
		fontSize = 46,
		fontWeight = 800,
		letterSpacing = 2,
		uppercase = true,
		color,
		ribbon = true,
		ribbonColor = '#ff3e00',
		ribbonWidth = 86,
		edgeFade = 0,
		pauseOnHover = true,
		cross = false,
		crossColor,
		crossAngle = 16,
		draggable = false,
		scrollBoost = 0,
		outline = false,
		outlineWidth = 1.5,
		className = '',
		style = {}
	}: TextLoopProps = $props();

	let rootEl: HTMLDivElement | undefined = $state();
	let svgEl: SVGSVGElement | undefined = $state();
	let pathEl: SVGPathElement | undefined = $state();
	let crossPathEl: SVGPathElement | undefined = $state();
	let measureEl: SVGTextElement | undefined = $state();
	let headEl: SVGTextPathElement | undefined = $state();
	let tailEl: SVGTextPathElement | undefined = $state();
	let crossHeadEl: SVGTextPathElement | undefined = $state();
	let crossTailEl: SVGTextPathElement | undefined = $state();
	let progress = 0;

	let metrics: Metrics = $state({ length: 0, reps: 1, crossLength: 0, crossReps: 1 });

	const rawId = $props.id();
	const pathId = `text-loop-${rawId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '')}`;
	const crossId = `${pathId}-cross`;
	const fadeId = `${pathId}-fade`;
	const maskId = `${pathId}-mask`;
	const shadowId = `${pathId}-shadow`;
	const underId = `${pathId}-under`;

	const custom = $derived(Boolean(path));
	const d = $derived(path || buildPath(shape, curviness, ribbonWidth));
	const crossD = $derived.by(() => {
		if (!cross) return '';
		if (path) return path;
		return buildPath(shape, curviness, ribbonWidth, shape === 'wave' || shape === 'arch' || shape === 'circle');
	});
	const fade = $derived(buildFade(edgeFade));
	const fill = $derived(color || (ribbon ? '#ffffff' : 'currentColor'));

	const half = $derived(cross ? crossAngle / 2 : 0);
	const mainAngle = $derived(tilt + half);
	const crossAngleDeg = $derived(tilt - half);
	const mainTransform = $derived(mainAngle ? `rotate(${mainAngle} ${CX} ${CY})` : undefined);
	const crossTransform = $derived(crossAngleDeg ? `rotate(${crossAngleDeg} ${CX} ${CY})` : undefined);
	const crossTape = $derived(crossColor || tint(ribbonColor, 0.62));
	const crossFill = $derived(ribbon ? inkOn(crossTape) : crossColor || 'currentColor');
	const crossDim = $derived(!ribbon && !crossColor ? 0.45 : 1);

	const unit = $derived.by(() => {
		const base = uppercase ? String(text).toUpperCase() : String(text);
		const gap = separator ? ` ${separator} ` : '   ';
		return `${base}${gap}`;
	});

	const textStyle = $derived(`font-size:${fontSize}px;font-weight:${fontWeight};letter-spacing:${letterSpacing}px`);

	$effect(() => {
		void d;
		void crossD;
		void unit;
		void fontSize;
		void fontWeight;
		void letterSpacing;
		const pathNode = pathEl;
		const measureNode = measureEl;
		const crossNode = crossPathEl;
		if (!pathNode || !measureNode) return;

		let cancelled = false;

		const measure = () => {
			if (cancelled) return;
			let length = 0;
			let unitWidth = 0;
			let crossLength = 0;
			try {
				length = pathNode.getTotalLength();
				unitWidth = measureNode.getComputedTextLength();
				crossLength = crossNode && crossNode.isConnected ? crossNode.getTotalLength() : 0;
			} catch {
				return;
			}
			if (!length) return;

			const repsFor = (total: number) => (unitWidth > 0 ? Math.max(1, Math.round(total / unitWidth)) : 1);
			const next = { length, reps: repsFor(length), crossLength, crossReps: repsFor(crossLength) };
			const prev = untrack(() => metrics);
			if (
				prev.length === next.length &&
				prev.reps === next.reps &&
				prev.crossLength === next.crossLength &&
				prev.crossReps === next.crossReps
			)
				return;
			metrics = next;
		};

		measure();
		if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.fonts?.ready) {
			document.fonts.ready.then(measure).catch(() => {});
		}

		return () => {
			cancelled = true;
		};
	});

	$effect(() => {
		const { length, crossLength } = metrics;
		const head = headEl;
		const tail = tailEl;
		const root = rootEl;
		const svg = svgEl;
		const crossHead = crossHeadEl;
		const crossTail = crossTailEl;
		const settings = {
			speed,
			direction,
			pauseOnHover,
			draggable,
			scrollBoost,
			cross,
			custom,
			shape,
			mainAngle,
			curviness,
			ribbonWidth
		};
		if (!head || !tail || !root || !svg || !length) return;

		return untrack(() => {
			const crossPaths =
				settings.cross && crossHead && crossTail && crossLength > 0 ? [crossHead, crossTail] : null;

			let travel = progress * length;
			const apply = () => {
				const offset = wrap(travel, length);
				progress = offset / length;
				head.setAttribute('startOffset', String(offset));
				tail.setAttribute('startOffset', String(offset - length));
				if (crossPaths) {
					const crossOffset = wrap(-travel, crossLength);
					crossPaths[0].setAttribute('startOffset', String(crossOffset));
					crossPaths[1].setAttribute('startOffset', String(crossOffset - crossLength));
				}
			};
			apply();

			const reduced = Boolean(window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')?.matches);
			const sign = settings.direction === 'reverse' ? -1 : 1;
			const base = reduced ? 0 : Math.max(0, settings.speed) * sign;
			const hover = { scale: 1 };
			const angle = (settings.mainAngle * Math.PI) / 180;
			const circular = !settings.custom && settings.shape === 'circle';
			const radius = circleRadius(settings.curviness, settings.ribbonWidth);
			const boostAmount = settings.scrollBoost;
			const boosting = boostAmount > 0 && !reduced;

			let fling = 0;
			let boost = 0;
			let scrollVelocity = 0;
			let scrollAt = 0;
			let scrollPos = 0;
			let scrollSource: EventTarget | null = null;
			let dragging = false;
			let pointerId: number | null = null;
			let lastX = 0;
			let lastY = 0;
			let lastT = 0;
			let velocity = 0;
			let center = { x: 0, y: 0 };
			let running = false;

			const tick = (_: number, deltaMs: number) => {
				if (dragging) return;
				const dt = Math.min(0.05, deltaMs / 1000);
				fling *= Math.exp(-dt / 0.55);
				if (boosting) {
					if (performance.now() - scrollAt > 90) scrollVelocity *= Math.exp(-dt / 0.12);
					const target = clamp(scrollVelocity * boostAmount * 0.35 * sign, -MAX_BOOST, MAX_BOOST);
					boost += (target - boost) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt / 0.18));
				}
				const v = base * hover.scale + fling + boost;
				if (Math.abs(v) < 0.01) return;
				travel += v * dt;
				apply();
			};

			const start = () => {
				if (running || reduced) return;
				running = true;
				gsap.ticker.add(tick);
			};
			const stop = () => {
				if (!running) return;
				running = false;
				gsap.ticker.remove(tick);
			};

			const glide = (hovered: boolean) =>
				gsap.to(hover, {
					scale: hovered ? 0 : 1,
					duration: hovered ? 0.6 : 0.9,
					ease: hovered ? 'power2.out' : 'power2.inOut',
					overwrite: true
				});
			const onEnter = (event: PointerEvent) => {
				if (event.pointerType !== 'touch') glide(true);
			};
			const onLeave = () => glide(false);

			const onDown = (event: PointerEvent) => {
				if (event.pointerType === 'mouse' && event.button !== 0) return;
				dragging = true;
				pointerId = event.pointerId;
				root.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);
				lastX = event.clientX;
				lastY = event.clientY;
				lastT = performance.now();
				velocity = base * hover.scale + fling + boost;
				const rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
				center = { x: rect.left + rect.width / 2, y: rect.top + rect.height / 2 };
				root.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
			};
			const onMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
				if (!dragging || event.pointerId !== pointerId) return;
				const now = performance.now();
				let delta: number;
				if (circular) {
					let turn =
						Math.atan2(event.clientY - center.y, event.clientX - center.x) -
						Math.atan2(lastY - center.y, lastX - center.x);
					if (turn > Math.PI) turn -= Math.PI * 2;
					if (turn < -Math.PI) turn += Math.PI * 2;
					delta = turn * radius;
				} else {
					const scale = VIEW_W / (svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || VIEW_W);
					delta = ((event.clientX - lastX) * Math.cos(angle) + (event.clientY - lastY) * Math.sin(angle)) * scale;
				}
				travel += delta;
				apply();
				const dt = Math.max(1, now - lastT) / 1000;
				velocity = velocity * 0.6 + (delta / dt) * 0.4;
				lastX = event.clientX;
				lastY = event.clientY;
				lastT = now;
			};
			const onUp = (event: PointerEvent) => {
				if (!dragging || event.pointerId !== pointerId) return;
				dragging = false;
				pointerId = null;
				root.style.cursor = '';
				if (reduced) return;
				const release = performance.now() - lastT > 90 ? 0 : clamp(velocity, -MAX_FLING, MAX_FLING);
				fling = release - (base * hover.scale + boost);
			};

			const onScroll = (event: Event) => {
				const source = event.target;
				const isPage = source === document || source === document.documentElement || source === document.body;
				if (!isPage && !(source instanceof Node && source.contains(root))) return;
				const pos = isPage ? window.scrollY : (source as Element).scrollTop;
				const now = performance.now();
				if (source !== scrollSource || now - scrollAt > 200) {
					scrollSource = source;
					scrollPos = pos;
					scrollAt = now;
					return;
				}
				const instant = (pos - scrollPos) / (Math.max(8, now - scrollAt) / 1000);
				scrollVelocity = scrollVelocity * 0.5 + instant * 0.5;
				scrollPos = pos;
				scrollAt = now;
			};

			if (settings.pauseOnHover) {
				root.addEventListener('pointerenter', onEnter);
				root.addEventListener('pointerleave', onLeave);
			}
			if (settings.draggable) {
				root.addEventListener('pointerdown', onDown);
				root.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
				root.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
				root.addEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
			}
			if (boosting) window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { capture: true, passive: true });

			const observer =
				typeof IntersectionObserver !== 'undefined'
					? new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
							if (entry.isIntersecting) start();
							else stop();
						})
					: null;
			if (observer) observer.observe(root);
			else start();

			return () => {
				observer?.disconnect();
				stop();
				gsap.killTweensOf(hover);
				root.style.cursor = '';
				root.removeEventListener('pointerenter', onEnter);
				root.removeEventListener('pointerleave', onLeave);
				root.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onDown);
				root.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
				root.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
				root.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
				window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { capture: true });
			};
		});
	});

	const loopText = $derived(unit.repeat(metrics.reps));
	const crossText = $derived(unit.repeat(metrics.crossReps));
	const fitLength = $derived(metrics.length || undefined);
	const crossFit = $derived(metrics.crossLength || undefined);
	const paint = (ink: string, opacity: number): Record<string, string | number> =>
		outline
			? {
					fill: 'none',
					stroke: ink,
					'stroke-opacity': opacity,
					'stroke-width': outlineWidth,
					'stroke-linejoin': 'round'
				}
			: { fill: ink, 'fill-opacity': opacity };
	const mainPaint = $derived(paint(fill, 1));
	const crossPaint = $derived(paint(crossFill, crossDim));
</script>

<div
	bind:this={rootEl}
	class={`relative w-full overflow-hidden ${draggable ? 'cursor-grab touch-pan-y' : ''} ${className}`.trim()}
	style={css(style) || undefined}
>
	<svg
		bind:this={svgEl}
		class="block w-full h-auto"
		viewBox={`0 0 ${VIEW_W} ${VIEW_H}`}
		preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
		role="img"
		aria-label={text}
	>
		<defs>
			{#if fade.length > 0}
				<linearGradient id={fadeId} x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
					{#each fade as stop, i (i)}
						<stop offset={stop.offset} stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity={stop.opacity} />
					{/each}
				</linearGradient>
				<mask id={maskId} maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x="0" y="0" width={VIEW_W} height={VIEW_H}>
					<rect width={VIEW_W} height={VIEW_H} fill={`url(#${fadeId})`} />
				</mask>
			{/if}
			{#if cross && ribbon}
				<filter
					id={shadowId}
					filterUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
					x={-VIEW_W}
					y={-VIEW_H}
					width={VIEW_W * 3}
					height={VIEW_H * 3}
				>
					<feGaussianBlur stdDeviation={Math.max(4, ribbonWidth * 0.11)} />
				</filter>
				<mask
					id={underId}
					maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
					x={-VIEW_W}
					y={-VIEW_H}
					width={VIEW_W * 3}
					height={VIEW_H * 3}
				>
					<g transform={crossTransform}>
						<path
							d={crossD}
							fill="none"
							stroke="#ffffff"
							stroke-width={ribbonWidth}
							stroke-linecap="round"
							stroke-linejoin="round"
						/>
					</g>
				</mask>
			{/if}
		</defs>

		<text bind:this={measureEl} class="invisible pointer-events-none" style={textStyle} aria-hidden="true">{unit}</text>

		<g mask={fade.length > 0 ? `url(#${maskId})` : undefined}>
			{#if cross}
				<g transform={crossTransform}>
					<path
						bind:this={crossPathEl}
						id={crossId}
						d={crossD}
						fill="none"
						stroke={ribbon ? crossTape : 'none'}
						stroke-width={ribbon ? ribbonWidth : 0}
						stroke-linecap="round"
						stroke-linejoin="round"
					/>

					<text
						class="select-none"
						style={textStyle}
						{...crossPaint}
						dominant-baseline="central"
						aria-hidden="true"
						textLength={crossFit}
						lengthAdjust="spacing"
					>
						<textPath bind:this={crossHeadEl} href={`#${crossId}`} startOffset="0">{crossText}</textPath>
					</text>

					<text
						class="select-none"
						style={textStyle}
						{...crossPaint}
						dominant-baseline="central"
						aria-hidden="true"
						textLength={crossFit}
						lengthAdjust="spacing"
					>
						<textPath bind:this={crossTailEl} href={`#${crossId}`} startOffset="0">{crossText}</textPath>
					</text>
				</g>
			{/if}

			{#if cross && ribbon}
				<g mask={`url(#${underId})`}>
					<g filter={`url(#${shadowId})`} transform={`translate(0 ${Math.max(4, ribbonWidth * 0.08)})`}>
						<g transform={mainTransform}>
							<path
								{d}
								fill="none"
								stroke="#000000"
								stroke-opacity={0.42}
								stroke-width={ribbonWidth}
								stroke-linecap="round"
								stroke-linejoin="round"
							/>
						</g>
					</g>
				</g>
			{/if}

			<g transform={mainTransform}>
				<path
					bind:this={pathEl}
					id={pathId}
					{d}
					fill="none"
					stroke={ribbon ? ribbonColor : 'none'}
					stroke-width={ribbon ? ribbonWidth : 0}
					stroke-linecap="round"
					stroke-linejoin="round"
				/>

				<text
					class="select-none"
					style={textStyle}
					{...mainPaint}
					dominant-baseline="central"
					aria-hidden="true"
					textLength={fitLength}
					lengthAdjust="spacing"
				>
					<textPath bind:this={headEl} href={`#${pathId}`} startOffset="0">{loopText}</textPath>
				</text>

				<text
					class="select-none"
					style={textStyle}
					{...mainPaint}
					dominant-baseline="central"
					aria-hidden="true"
					textLength={fitLength}
					lengthAdjust="spacing"
				>
					<textPath bind:this={tailEl} href={`#${pathId}`} startOffset="0">{loopText}</textPath>
				</text>
			</g>
		</g>
	</svg>
</div>
